title: 한국해양과학기술원법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130324:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 24, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (48) Omitted.

(49) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology Act shall be amended as follows:

In Article 2 (1) 6, paragraphs (2) and (3) of that Article, Article 3 (2), Article 4 (2), and Article 5 (4) and (5), "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries".

(50) through (63) Omitted.
